The coal is classed as subbituminous "B" grade with a heating value of about 8,450 Btu/lb. The average sulfur content of both beds is 0.73 percent which is equivalent to 1.73 lbs of SO<sub>2</sub> per million Btu fired. The ash and moisture content of the coal are approximately 9 percent and 25 percent respectively. Table II-9 gives the average proximate and ultimate analysis of the coal for both tracts (Westmoreland Resources, 1975 a).
